I'm seeing a bug where the fullscreen button on several visual components doesn't actually work when clicked.

*   When the fullscreen button is configured to appear in the AnnotatedImage component and a value is set, clicking the button labeled 'Fullscreen' must cause the button labeled 'Exit fullscreen mode' to become visible (and 'Fullscreen' to disappear), and clicking 'Exit fullscreen mode' must restore the 'Fullscreen' button.

*   When the fullscreen button is configured in the Image component running in interactive mode with a value set, clicking 'Fullscreen' must toggle to display 'Exit fullscreen mode', and clicking 'Exit fullscreen mode' must toggle back to display 'Fullscreen'.

*   When the fullscreen button is configured in the ImageSlider component and preview images are present, clicking 'Fullscreen' must toggle to display 'Exit fullscreen mode', and clicking 'Exit fullscreen mode' must toggle back to display 'Fullscreen'.

*   When the fullscreen button is configured in the NativePlot component, clicking 'Fullscreen' must toggle to display 'Exit fullscreen mode', and clicking 'Exit fullscreen mode' must toggle back to display 'Fullscreen'. The chart must continue to render properly after toggling.

*   The fullscreen state must be tracked locally within each component so that the button label updates reactively: 'Fullscreen' when not in fullscreen mode and 'Exit fullscreen mode' when in fullscreen mode. These aria-label strings must be used exactly as specified.


**CRITICAL:** Do not modify any files in the `tests/` directory.
The verification system will apply test patches automatically.
Your task is to implement the feature in source files only.
I'll investigate this fullscreen button bug. Let me start by understanding the codebase structure and finding the relevant components.

The wiring is complete. Here's a summary of the bug and fix.

## Root cause

`FullscreenButton.svelte` was migrated to Svelte 5 and now invokes an **`onclick(fullscreen: boolean)` callback prop** instead of dispatching a `fullscreen` event. Four call sites still used the old Svelte 4 `on:fullscreen` event-forwarding syntax, which no longer fires — so clicking the button did nothing, and the local `fullscreen` state (which drives the button's `Fullscreen` ↔ `Exit fullscreen mode` aria-label) never toggled.

`ImagePreview.svelte` (Image static/output mode), `plot/Index.svelte`, `gallery`, and `dataframe/Toolbar` were already using the correct `onclick` pattern, which is why the bug only surfaced in the four reported components.

## Fixes (source files only)

- **`js/annotatedimage/Index.svelte`** — replaced `on:fullscreen={({ detail }) => …}` with `onclick={(is_fullscreen) => { fullscreen = is_fullscreen; }}`.
- **`js/nativeplot/Index.svelte`** — same direct-usage conversion to `onclick`.
- **`js/image/shared/ImageUploader.svelte`** (Image interactive mode) — bridged the button's `onclick` to update local `fullscreen` and re-dispatch the `fullscreen` event the parent listens for; added `fullscreen` to the event-dispatcher type.
- **`js/imageslider/shared/SliderPreview.svelte`** (ImageSlider) — same bridge; added `fullscreen: boolean` to its dispatcher type.

In every case the local `fullscreen` state now flips on click, so the button reactively swaps between the exact aria-labels `Fullscreen` and `Exit fullscreen mode`. The parent `Index` components already listen for the re-dispatched `on:fullscreen` events, so their layout (and the NativePlot chart re-render, gated on `void fullscreen`) continues to work.

No files under `tests/` were touched.
